title: Soulbound XP
description: Reworks XP Bar and orbs, making it look like Souls.
body:
Mod changes the XP from usual green - to cyan tones, just like the Souls in Soul Valley of the nether.
- The mod was inspired by an old resource pack for older versions that changed XP bar and XP orbs to blue, making them look like souls.

If you have suggestions or ideas, feel free to contact me on Discord: CrxwnLock
